overloads.semanticRole: DIFFERENCE compares set1 and set2 and excludes all records that are in set2 from the resultSet .

constraints: set1 and set2 must be sets on the same table; resultSet belongs to that same table.
resultSet replaces any existing set with the same name, including if that name is set1 or set2 itself.
In Client/Server mode, all three sets must be visible on the same machine (visibility depends on set type -- interprocess/process/local -- and where each set was created, server or client).
